stack.service: Rail402 service in process, Postgres, the private Stellar network behind a fault proxy
stack.rules: deploy/monitoring/alerts.ts with every for: 0s, evaluated every 2 s

fault.method: the RPC proxy answers every request with HTTP 503

steps: read /ready: 503; /health warnings: rpc_unhealthy, contract_ttl_critical
asked the provider directly: HTTP 503
restored the provider and waited for /ready

verifiedBy: /ready answered 503 during the outage
the provider answered 503 when asked directly
/ready answered 200 after the provider returned
an exact payment settled after recovery

checks.name: /ready answered 503 during the outage
the provider answered 503 when asked directly
/ready answered 200 after the provider returned
an exact payment settled after recovery

notes: A one-network local stack (testnet only): isolation between two networks served by one process is not exercised by this run.

cases.title: A channel's sequence used outside the service

fault.method: a transaction from the leased channel account, signed with its derived key, submitted outside the service

steps: looked the transaction the service did not send up by its hash: SUCCESS
settled a new payment through the service

verifiedBy: the conflicting transaction is on the ledger
the affected settlement was not reported as settled (answered settlement_pending)
the next settlement succeeded

checks.name: the conflicting transaction is on the ledger
the affected settlement was not reported as settled (answered settlement_pending)
the next settlement succeeded

fault.method: a payment held past its expiration ledger before /settle

paid again with a fresh payment

verifiedBy: the late settle was refused as expired (invalid_exact_stellar_signature_expired)
a fresh payment settled

transactions.role: cold signer added to the old sponsor, signed offline
sequence bump by the leaked key

fault.method: a leaked sponsor seed: the cold key locked the old key out and swept, then the service restarted with a new, funded sponsor seed on the same database

steps: added the cold signer to the old sponsor (unsigned setup signed offline by deploy/stellar-keys.ts)
prepared the cold key's freeze, then bumped the old sponsor's sequence with the leaked key (as an attacker would)
locked the old key out with the cold key (deploy/keys/cli.ts freeze: master weight 0, from the cold account)
swept 100 XLM to the treasury in a second cold-signed transaction (deploy/keys/cli.ts sweep)
funded the new sponsor
replaced the sponsor secret and restarted
read /health and settled one payment

verifiedBy: the payment before the rotation was fee-bumped by the old sponsor
the leaked key bumped the old sponsor's sequence before the freeze
the cold key's freeze applied: the old key's weight is 0
the leaked key alone can no longer pay (sendTransaction ERROR: txBadAuth)
/health names the new sponsor
the payment after the rotation settled
the payment after the rotation was fee-bumped by the new sponsor

checks.name: the payment before the rotation was fee-bumped by the old sponsor
the leaked key bumped the old sponsor's sequence before the freeze
the cold key's freeze applied: the old key's weight is 0
the leaked key alone can no longer pay (sendTransaction ERROR: txBadAuth)
/health names the new sponsor
the payment after the rotation settled
the payment after the rotation was fee-bumped by the new sponsor

notes: A one-network local stack (testnet only): isolation between two networks served by one process is not exercised by this run.
The old channel accounts were not retired in this drill; the upto authority switch is not part of a local run (upto off).

fault.method: 10 settlements at once against 2 channel accounts, with confirmation held back

steps: read the refusals: 8 of 10 (settle_exact_stellar_channel_unavailable)
let the burst drain; rail402_channels_in_use is 0 afterwards

verifiedBy: every refusal during the burst was the retryable channel_unavailable
no channel stayed leased after the burst
the next settlement succeeded

the next settlement succeeded

cases.title: The fee sponsor runs low and is topped up

fault.method: the sponsor's balance spent down to about 200 XLM, below its 250 XLM reserve and 300 XLM readiness floor

steps: checked the spend: one payment out of the sponsor account, not settlement fees
topped up 5000 XLM from the treasury to the recorded sponsor address (buildTopUp refuses any other destination)
waited for /ready

verifiedBy: /ready failed while the sponsor was below its floor
a settlement was refused while the sponsor was below its reserve (settle_exact_stellar_sponsor_unavailable)
/ready answered 200 after the top-up
an exact payment settled after the top-up

checks.name: /ready failed while the sponsor was below its floor
a settlement was refused while the sponsor was below its reserve (settle_exact_stellar_sponsor_unavailable)
/ready answered 200 after the top-up
an exact payment settled after the top-up

cases.title: The embedding model is missing at a restart

fault.method: a restart with the embedding model files missing

steps: the replica refused to start: rail402: startup_failed: embedding model file <model directory>/all-minilm-l6-v2/model.onnx is missing; fetch it or enable downloads
restarted with lexical search (SEARCH_EMBEDDINGS=false) until the model files are restored

verifiedBy: the replica refused to start without its model files
search answers HTTP 200 with lexical search (partialResults true)
an exact payment settled after the restart

checks.name: the replica refused to start without its model files
search answers HTTP 200 with lexical search (partialResults true)
an exact payment settled after the restart
